newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris judge to probe council run by Juppe ally.
newsitem.headline: Paris judge to probe council run by Juppe ally.

text.p: A Paris magistrate will investigate suspect financial transactions by a regional council run by the secretary-general of Prime Minister Alain Juppe's conservative party, judicial sources said on Monday.

The sources said magistrate Edith Boizette would examine awards of public works contracts by the regional council of the Oise department north of the capital, which is headed by Jean-Francois Mancel, secretary-general of the Rally for the Republic Party (RPR).
The investigation is linked to a probe launched in 1995 into businessman Michel Pacary on suspicions of serving as a go-between in paying secret commissions to RPR deputies around France.
Juppe in September publicly reaffirmed support for Mancel after Mancel accused officials close to the premier of seeking to destabilise him.
France has been rocked by a string of political funding scandals in recent years, affecting all mainstream parties.
